content: Claimable Business Listings Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000028644 Start generating passive revenue with the Claimable Business Listing Add-On. This tool converts imported business data into paying members – a strategy used by Yelp and Yellow Pages. When they find their business profile on the website, they can pay the website to CLAIM that listing and take over the account and add more relevant information about their business. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Claimable Business Listings Add-On Using the Add-On The list of documents below provide a detailed guide on how to use Claimable listings The Ultimate Guide To Claim Listings - Part 1 The Ultimate Guide To Claim Listings - Part 2 The Ultimate Guide To Claim Listings – Part 3 How Do I Manage Leads Sent To Claim Listings? VIDEO: Claimable Business Listings - Best Practices & Use Cases Highly Recommended Create the Claim Listing Plan Finance >> Membership plans >> Click on Membership plan + : For this new membership plan, add a title, in this example, call it " My Claim Listings " because it is just a placeholder, a vessel to group our Claim Listing Members. Set up Claim Account Type On the Sign Ups & Upgrades select under Account Type : " Claim " Claim Listing Web Link The Claim Listing Web Link setting is used to specify the URL that the " Claim Listing " button will lead to when the user claiming the listing click on that button, they will be redirected to the link specified in the plan settings, by default this will link to the /Join Page. " Make a Connection" / "Claim Listing" Banner Position On the Profile Page tab on the Membership plan settings there is a setting " Make a Connection" / "Claim Listing" Banner Position to determine the positioning of the claim listing banner, the options are: - Above Profile Photo - Below Profile Photo - Hide - Do Not Display This is how the Claim listing would show in the member profile: When the Account type is set to Claim both setting below are disabled as members cannot sign up to a claim listing membership plan. When the account type is saved as "Claim", the system will show with the "Sign-Up Page" URL disabled. So now we have the Claim Listings Plan: Assign the Claim Listing Plan when Importing IMPORTANT It is not necessary to add an email to the import file because the system will auto-generate emails for them. If the admin does not know how to format the CSV import file please check the following resource Importing Members Via CSV file . Once the import file is ready to be imported, the admin must do the following so the claim listing members are in the proper membership level. Go to Members >> Import Members >> Import CSV File: Then select the membership plan "My Claim Listings": Now go to Finance >> Membership Plans to view the claim listing members: Members Claim Their Listing Go to Members >> Search Members >> Click on Actions >> View Live Profile: Now the admin can see that there is a Claim Listing message, the prospective member will need to click the Claim Listing button to claim their listing: Once they clicked the button, the system will take them to the pricing page to select the Membership Level or Product, that they would like to acquire on the website: The website will take them to a secure page to add their email and password: Lastly, they can add all of their details to their profile: Send Claim Email There's no premade email template that will invite users to claim their profile. But this can be easily created in the Emails » Email Templates » New Email Template . To add a link that will take the user directly to their profile page use the following: %protocol_website_url%/%filename% Once the email template is ready it can be selected in the newsletter tool: Emails » Send Newsletter » New Email Newsletter To get recommendations on how to proceed with an email campaign for Claim Listings, please refer to the following article: The Ultimate Guide To Claim Listings – Part 3 For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
